official_source.title: FIFA Futsal Laws of the Game 2025-26 (Notes: youth organisational modifications)
official_source.version_label: 2025-26 Notes on the Futsal Laws; youth/veterans/disability/grassroots organisational modifications

notes: FIFA Notes allow youth modifications: pitch; ball; goals; captain armband; duration of the two equal periods and extra-time periods; GK throw limits. Age bands set by FA/confederation/FIFA. No other changes without FIFA permission. rules/youth.json keeps Law 7 20-minute halves as parent baseline when duration is unmodified; confirm local timing before air.
